motion.name: control-color
motion.purpose: Button and tab hover state only; no content entrance sequence.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Explicit action on a flat sheet.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; min-height: 40px; font: 500 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-in-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: hsl(var(--primary) / .9); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline button
components.description: Location and refresh controls without elevation.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { background: hsl(var(--background)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 36px; font: 500 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-in-out; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: hsl(var(--accent)); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search input
components.description: Search and assistant entry with visible focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: hsl(var(--background)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; height: 40px; font: 400 16px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation tab
components.description: Underlined main task navigation; one active item.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); } .ds-tab { background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; padding: 8px 2px; min-height: 40px; font: 500 14px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover, .ds-tab.ds-active { color: hsl(var(--primary)); } .ds-tab.ds-active { border-bottom-color: hsl(var(--primary)); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Assessed status
components.description: Short status word plus tint; no interaction implied.
components.css: .ds-status-allow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: hsl(var(--status-allow-bg)); color: hsl(var(--status-allow-fg)); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 10px; font: 600 13px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Ruled activity row
components.description: One activity, instruction and status in a continuous list.
components.html:
Morning AssemblyALLOW

Proceed normally with regular outdoor activities.
components.css: .ds-row { background: hsl(var(--card)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); padding: 16px 20px; font: 400 15px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row strong { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-row span { float: right; color: hsl(var(--status-allow-fg)); } .ds-row p { clear: both; margin: 6px 0 0; }

narrative.overview: Staff consult ClearClass before school opens, often on a phone. The interface reads like an operational risk-assessment sheet: a short assessed stance, the cohort switch, then one ruled activity list. It is deliberately a reading surface rather than a dashboard of repeated metrics. Air provenance, unavailable guidance, and model limitations remain visible where they affect the decision.

rules.name: The Provenance Rule
rules.body: A model forecast, cached forecast, demo scenario, stale forecast, and unavailable forecast are labeled as different states. No reference AQI appears when the API value is null; no forecast is presented as a campus measurement.

rules.name: The Instruction Rule
rules.body: Name the action before its rationale. A row never relies on its status color alone.

dos: Do keep decisions attached to the affected activity and cohort, especially when guidance is mixed or withheld.
Do show status words and source context alongside tint; permit scanning without color vision.
Do let long Hindi and source names wrap naturally without horizontal document overflow.
donts: Don't duplicate the four verdicts in a hero tile grid above their actual instructions.
Don't present synthetic, stale, unavailable or modelled data as live campus observations.
Don't use decorative gradients, pulsing badges, micro-labels, or nested icon-card panels in the operating surface.
